title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — Overview
An outdoor, team-based conditioning class with sled pushes, sandbag carries, sprints and partner circuits.

title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — When and who
- Saturday 9:00am with Jordan Lee.
- 60 minutes, outdoors in car park area B (coned off for the class), maximum 25 people.

title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — Weather
Bootcamp runs in light rain. In heavy rain, lightning or temperatures above 35°C it moves indoors to Studio 1 with a reduced format. Any change is announced in the member app by 7:00am.

title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — Level
All levels; you work at your own pace within the team.

title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — What to bring
Outdoor training shoes, water, and layers in cold weather.

title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — Monthly challenge
On the last Saturday of each month, Bootcamp is the IronPulse Community Challenge (see Community Events).

title: Saturday Bootcamp
text:
Saturday Bootcamp — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Boxing
text:
Boxing — Overview
A non-contact boxing fitness class: footwork, combinations on pads and heavy bags, plus conditioning rounds. There is no sparring.

title: Boxing
text:
Boxing — When and who
- Wednesday 6:00pm with Alex Chen.
- 60 minutes, Studio 1, maximum 16 people.

title: Boxing
text:
Boxing — Level
All levels. Alex teaches the basic stance and punches at the start of every class.

title: Boxing
text:
Boxing — What to bring
- Boxing gloves can be borrowed free from the studio.
- Hand wraps are personal for hygiene reasons: bring your own or buy a pair at the front desk for $8.
- Water bottle and towel.

title: Boxing
text:
Boxing — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist
text:
Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist — Who can book
Plus members (one class per week, Monday–Sunday) and Elite members (unlimited). Basic and Student members cannot book classes.

title: Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist
text:
Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist — How to book
- In the IronPulse member app (Classes tab) or at the front desk.
- Booking opens 7 days before the class at the same time of day, e.g. Monday 7:00am HIIT opens the previous Monday at 7:00am.
- You can hold a maximum of 4 future bookings at once.

title: Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist
text:
Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist — Cancelling
- Cancel at least 2 hours before the class in the app or at the front desk.
- Later cancellations and no-shows count as a used class (for Plus, it is your class for that week).
- Elite members with three no-shows within 30 days cannot book for 7 days.

title: Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist
text:
Class Booking, Cancellation and Waitlist — Waitlist
- When a class is full you can join the waitlist in the app (maximum 10 people).
- Elite members are placed ahead of Plus members.
- If a spot opens up to 2 hours before the class, the first person is booked automatically and gets a push notification. Within the last 2 hours, spots are offered by notification and the first person to accept gets it.

title: Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips
text:
Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips — Before class
- Arrive 5–10 minutes early; first-timers should introduce themselves to the instructor and mention any injuries.
- Check in on the studio tablet or the instructor will mark you absent.
- Phones on silent and kept in the cubbies, not on the floor.

title: Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips
text:
Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips — Late entry rules
- HIIT and Spin: doors close 10 minutes after the start (safety).
- Restorative Yoga: no entry after 10:15am.
- All other classes: late entry up to 10 minutes after the start, quietly at the back.

title: Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips
text:
Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips — During and after class
- Follow the instructor's safety cues and take the easier option if anything hurts.
- Wipe down and return all equipment — mats, bells and bands go back to the marked shelves.
- Leave the studio promptly; the next class may need a set-up window.

title: Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips
text:
Class Etiquette and First-Class Tips — Feedback
Class feedback can be left in the app after each session; instructors read it weekly.

title: Core
text:
Core — Overview
A short, focused class for the abdominals, obliques and lower back, using planks, carries, cable work and stability-ball exercises.

title: Core
text:
Core — When and who
- Friday 5:00pm with Alex Chen.
- 30 minutes, Studio 1, maximum 20 people.

title: Core
text:
Core — Level
All levels. It's a popular add-on before or after a gym-floor workout.

title: Core
text:
Core — Good to know
Because it is only 30 minutes, it still counts as one full class for Plus members' weekly allowance.

title: Core
text:
Core — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
text:
HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) — Overview
HIIT alternates short bursts of hard work with brief recovery, using bodyweight moves, kettlebells, rowers and assault bikes.

title: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
text:
HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) — When and who
- Monday 7:00am, Wednesday 7:00am and Thursday 6:00pm, all with Jordan Lee.
- 45 minutes, Studio 1, maximum 20 people.

title: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
text:
HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) — Level
All levels. Jordan gives an easier and a harder option for every exercise. If you are new to exercise or returning from injury, tell Jordan before the class starts.

title: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
text:
HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) — What to bring
Water bottle, towel and training shoes with good grip. Mats and equipment are provided.

title: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
text:
HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) — Late arrival
The doors close 10 minutes after the start because the warm-up is part of the safety plan. If you arrive later you won't be admitted, and it counts as a no-show.

title: HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training)
text:
HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training) — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Pilates
text:
Pilates — Overview
Mat Pilates focused on core control, posture and the small stabilising muscles around the hips and spine. IronPulse runs mat Pilates only — there are no reformer machines.

title: Pilates
text:
Pilates — When and who
- Tuesday 12:00pm and Friday 12:00pm with Sam Rivera.
- 50 minutes, Studio 1, maximum 15 people (smaller group so Sam can correct form).

title: Pilates
text:
Pilates — Level
Beginner to intermediate. Many members use it alongside strength training to protect the lower back.

title: Pilates
text:
Pilates — What to bring
Mats, small balls, rings and resistance bands are provided. Grip socks are recommended; they're sold at the front desk.

title: Pilates
text:
Pilates — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Restorative Yoga
text:
Restorative Yoga — Overview
A slow, calming class built around long, supported stretches held for several minutes, with breathing exercises. It is the gentlest class on the IronPulse timetable.

title: Restorative Yoga
text:
Restorative Yoga — When and who
- Sunday 10:00am with Sam Rivera.
- 75 minutes, Studio 1, maximum 25 people.

title: Restorative Yoga
text:
Restorative Yoga — Level
Suitable for everyone, including complete beginners and members recovering from hard training weeks.

title: Restorative Yoga
text:
Restorative Yoga — What to bring
Bolsters, blankets, blocks and mats are provided. Wear warm, comfortable clothing — the studio lights are dimmed and the room is kept cooler than in other classes.

title: Restorative Yoga
text:
Restorative Yoga — Good to know
Late entry is not allowed after 10:15am so the class can stay quiet.

title: Restorative Yoga
text:
Restorative Yoga — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Spin
text:
Spin — Overview
An indoor cycling class set to music, with climbs, sprints and intervals. You control the resistance, so it suits every fitness level.

title: Spin
text:
Spin — When and who
- Monday 6:00pm and Friday 7:00am with Jordan Lee.
- 45 minutes in the Spin Studio, which has 18 bikes — so the class is limited to 18 people.

title: Spin
text:
Spin — Level
All levels. First-timers should arrive 10 minutes early so Jordan can set up the bike (seat height, handlebars, cleats).

title: Spin
text:
Spin — What to bring
A water bottle and a small towel. Bikes take standard SPD cleats; trainers also work with the toe cages. Padded shorts are optional.

title: Spin
text:
Spin — Late arrival
Doors close 10 minutes after the start. Late arrivals are not admitted, and it counts as a no-show.

title: Spin
text:
Spin — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Strength
text:
Strength — Overview
A coached barbell and dumbbell class teaching the main lifts — squat, deadlift, bench press, overhead press and rows — with progressive weights week to week.

title: Strength
text:
Strength — When and who
- Tuesday 7:00am and Thursday 7:00am with Alex Chen.
- 60 minutes on the lifting platforms, maximum 12 people (one platform per two members).

title: Strength
text:
Strength — Level
Beginners are welcome: Alex starts every newcomer with an empty bar and checks technique before adding weight. Experienced lifters follow a written programme on the board.

title: Strength
text:
Strength — What to bring
Flat-soled shoes, a water bottle and a training log if you have one. Chalk is allowed on the lifting platforms only. Belts and wrist wraps are available to borrow.

title: Strength
text:
Strength — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Overview
All group classes take place in Studio 1, except Spin (Spin Studio) and Bootcamp (outdoors, car park area B). Group classes are included with Plus (1 per week) and Elite (unlimited). Basic and Student members cannot book classes.

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Monday
- 7:00am — HIIT with Jordan Lee (45 min)
- 12:00pm — Yoga with Sam Rivera (60 min)
- 6:00pm — Spin with Jordan Lee (45 min)

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Tuesday
- 7:00am — Strength with Alex Chen (60 min)
- 12:00pm — Pilates with Sam Rivera (50 min)

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Wednesday
- 7:00am — HIIT with Jordan Lee (45 min)
- 6:00pm — Boxing with Alex Chen (60 min)

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Thursday
- 7:00am — Strength with Alex Chen (60 min)
- 12:00pm — Yoga with Sam Rivera (60 min)
- 6:00pm — HIIT with Jordan Lee (45 min)

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Friday
- 7:00am — Spin with Jordan Lee (45 min)
- 12:00pm — Pilates with Sam Rivera (50 min)
- 5:00pm — Core with Alex Chen (30 min)

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Saturday
- 9:00am — Bootcamp with Jordan Lee (60 min)

title: Weekly Group Class Schedule
text:
Weekly Group Class Schedule — Sunday
- 10:00am — Restorative Yoga with Sam Rivera (75 min)
There are no classes on public holidays (see Holiday Hours and Closures).

title: Yoga
text:
Yoga — Overview
A flowing vinyasa-style class that builds flexibility, balance and core strength, finishing with a short relaxation.

title: Yoga
text:
Yoga — When and who
- Monday 12:00pm and Thursday 12:00pm with Sam Rivera.
- 60 minutes, Studio 1, maximum 25 people.

title: Yoga
text:
Yoga — Level
All levels; beginners are welcome. Sam shows modifications for tight hamstrings, wrists and lower backs.

title: Yoga
text:
Yoga — What to bring
Mats, blocks and straps are provided and cleaned after every class. You may bring your own mat. Train barefoot; leave shoes in the cubbies outside the studio.

title: Yoga
text:
Yoga — Good to know
- Arrive a few minutes early to set up quietly; late entry is allowed up to 10 minutes after the start.
- Pregnant members should get approval from their doctor first and tell Sam before class.
- For a slower, deeper stretch, see Restorative Yoga on Sundays.

title: Yoga
text:
Yoga — Included in
Plus (as your one class of the week) and Elite.

title: Accessibility
text:
Accessibility — Overview
IronPulse aims to be usable by everyone.

title: Accessibility
text:
Accessibility — Building
- Step-free entrance with an automatic door from the plaza, and two accessible parking bays next to the plaza entrance.
- All gym areas are on the ground floor; there are no stairs inside the gym.
- An accessible changing room with a shower seat, grab rails and an emergency pull cord.

title: Accessibility
text:
Accessibility — Equipment
- 3 cable machines and 2 upper-body cardio machines (arm ergometers) that can be used from a wheelchair.
- Adjustable benches and height-adjustable racks.

title: Accessibility
text:
Accessibility — Support
- Registered assistance dogs are welcome (not in the sauna or showers).
- A carer or support worker accompanying a member trains free of charge; register them at the front desk.
- Staff can give a guided tour and an extended intro session (up to 60 minutes instead of 30) on request.

title: Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers
text:
Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers — Changing rooms
Men's, women's and two private gender-neutral changing rooms, each with showers, toilets, hairdryers and a vanity area. Shampoo and body wash dispensers are in every shower.

title: Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers
text:
Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers — Day lockers (all plans)
- Free to use while you are in the building; bring your own padlock or buy one at the front desk for $6.
- Day lockers are emptied every night at 11:00pm and the contents go to lost property.

title: Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers
text:
Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers — Personal lockers (Plus and Elite)
- A permanent locker kept for you for as long as you are a Plus or Elite member, including during a freeze.
- The locker key card is issued at the front desk; a lost locker key card costs $10 to replace.
- If you downgrade to Basic or cancel, empty your locker by your last day of membership.

title: Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers
text:
Changing Rooms, Lockers and Showers — Towels
Bring your own, rent one for $2 at the front desk, or use the towel service included with Elite.

title: Gym Floor and Equipment
text:
Gym Floor and Equipment — Overview
The gym floor is about 900 square metres and is open to every plan during that plan's access hours.

title: Gym Floor and Equipment
text:
Gym Floor and Equipment — Strength area
- 6 squat racks with safety arms and 4 lifting platforms with bumper plates.
- Dumbbells from 2kg to 50kg, kettlebells from 4kg to 40kg.
- 2 cable crossover stations, a Smith machine, leg press, hack squat and 14 selectorised machines.

title: Gym Floor and Equipment
text:
Gym Floor and Equipment — Cardio area
- 12 treadmills, 8 bikes, 6 cross-trainers, 4 rowers, 3 stair climbers and 4 assault bikes.
- 30-minute limit at peak times (Monday–Friday 5:00pm–8:00pm) when others are waiting.

title: Gym Floor and Equipment
text:
Gym Floor and Equipment — Functional zone
Turf lane for sled pushes, battle ropes, plyo boxes, medicine balls and a rig for pull-ups and suspension trainers.

title: Gym Floor and Equipment
text:
Gym Floor and Equipment — What IronPulse does not have
No swimming pool, no squash or tennis courts, no reformer Pilates machines, and no climbing wall.

title: Holiday Hours and Closures
text:
Holiday Hours and Closures — Fully closed
- Christmas Day (25 December) and New Year's Day (1 January): the building is closed to everyone, including 24/7 access.

title: Holiday Hours and Closures
text:
Holiday Hours and Closures — Other public holidays
- Staffed hours are reduced to 8:00am–2:00pm.
- There are no group classes on public holidays. Bookings are not possible for those dates.
- 24/7 access for Plus and Elite members continues as normal outside the reduced staffed hours.

title: Holiday Hours and Closures
text:
Holiday Hours and Closures — Planned maintenance
- Each year the studio floors and the sauna are serviced during the first week of August. The sauna is closed for that week; the gym floor stays open.
- Any other planned closures are announced in the member app and by email at least 14 days in advance.

title: Holiday Hours and Closures
text:
Holiday Hours and Closures — Unexpected closures
Power cuts, severe weather or emergencies are announced in the app as soon as possible. Classes cancelled by IronPulse never count against a Plus member's weekly class.

title: Location and Contact Details
text:
Location and Contact Details — Address
IronPulse Fitness, 42 Foundry Lane, Riverside District (inside Ridgeway Plaza, ground floor, entrance next to the pharmacy).

title: Location and Contact Details
text:
Location and Contact Details — Contact
- Front desk phone: (555) 014-2290 — answered during staffed hours.
- General enquiries: hello@ironpulsefitness.example
- Membership changes and cancellations: membership@ironpulsefitness.example
- Billing: billing@ironpulsefitness.example
- Corporate partnerships: corporate@ironpulsefitness.example
- Privacy requests: privacy@ironpulsefitness.example
Emails are answered within 2 working days.

title: Location and Contact Details
text:
Location and Contact Details — Member app
The IronPulse app (iOS and Android) handles entry, class booking, freezes, payments and messages to the front desk.

title: Location and Contact Details
text:
Location and Contact Details — Getting here
See Parking and Getting Here for parking, bus routes and bike racks.

title: Opening Hours
text:
Opening Hours — Staffed hours
- Monday–Friday: 6:00am–10:00pm
- Saturday–Sunday: 8:00am–8:00pm
During staffed hours the front desk, studios, sauna (6:00am–9:00pm only) and shop are open and staff are on the gym floor.

title: Opening Hours
text:
Opening Hours — 24/7 access
Plus and Elite members aged 18+ can use the gym floor, changing rooms and showers at any time with their access card or app QR code. See the 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours policy.

title: Opening Hours
text:
Opening Hours — Who can come when
- Basic and Student members, guests and day-pass visitors: staffed hours only.
- Plus and Elite members: any time.

title: Opening Hours
text:
Opening Hours — Busiest times
The gym floor is busiest Monday–Thursday 5:00pm–8:00pm. The quietest staffed times are 10:00am–3:00pm on weekdays and after 6:00pm on Sundays.

title: Opening Hours
text:
Opening Hours — Public holidays
Opening hours change on public holidays — see Holiday Hours and Closures.

title: Parking and Getting Here
text:
Parking and Getting Here — Car parking
- IronPulse members park free for up to 2 hours in the Ridgeway Plaza car park. Validate your ticket on the scanner at the IronPulse front desk (during unstaffed hours, scan your app QR code at the car park exit instead).
- After 2 hours the plaza's normal parking charges apply.
- Area B of the car park is closed on Saturdays 8:45am–10:15am for the Bootcamp class.
- Two accessible parking bays are next to the plaza entrance.

title: Parking and Getting Here
text:
Parking and Getting Here — Public transport
- Bus routes 7 and 19 stop at "Foundry Lane", about 2 minutes' walk away.
- Riverside train station is a 12-minute walk.

title: Parking and Getting Here
text:
Parking and Getting Here — Bikes
A covered bike rack with 20 spaces is outside the entrance and covered by CCTV. Bring your own lock.

title: Parking and Getting Here
text:
Parking and Getting Here — Electric vehicles
Four EV charging points are on level 1 of the plaza car park (paid separately through the plaza).

title: Recovery Zone
text:
Recovery Zone — Overview
A quiet area next to the studios for stretching and recovery, open to members on every plan during their access hours.

title: Recovery Zone
text:
Recovery Zone — Equipment
- Foam rollers, massage balls, stretching straps and mats.
- 2 percussion massage guns, borrowed from the front desk with your access card (staffed hours only, 15 minutes each).
- A compression boots station for Elite members (book a 20-minute slot in the app).

title: Recovery Zone
text:
Recovery Zone — Rules
- No heavy training in the recovery zone — it's for stretching and mobility only.
- Keep voices low and phones on silent.
- Wipe down mats and rollers after use.

title: Recovery Zone
text:
Recovery Zone — Guided mobility
Sam Rivera's Restorative Yoga class (Sunday 10:00am) is the best class for recovery. For one-to-one mobility work, book a personal training session with Sam or Priya Nair.

title: Sauna Rules
text:
Sauna Rules — Who can use it
- Elite members aged 18+, and guests accompanying an Elite member.
- Basic, Student and Plus members do not have sauna access. A one-off sauna session is not sold separately.

title: Sauna Rules
text:
Sauna Rules — Hours
6:00am–9:00pm every day. The sauna is closed during unstaffed hours and for one week each August for servicing.

title: Sauna Rules
text:
Sauna Rules — Rules
- Maximum 15 minutes per session, then cool down before going back in.
- Swimwear or a towel wrap must be worn; sit on a towel.
- Maximum 8 people at a time.
- No phones, no glass bottles and no essential oils on the stones.
- Shower before entering.

title: Sauna Rules
text:
Sauna Rules — Health
Don't use the sauna if you are pregnant, have heart or blood pressure problems, or have been drinking alcohol, unless your doctor has said it is safe. Leave immediately if you feel dizzy or unwell and tell a staff member.

title: Wi-Fi and Other Amenities
text:
Wi-Fi and Other Amenities — Wi-Fi
Free Wi-Fi on the network "IronPulse-Members". The password changes monthly and is printed on the front desk board and shown in the app under Info.

title: Wi-Fi and Other Amenities
text:
Wi-Fi and Other Amenities — Water and drinks
- Filtered water fountains on the gym floor, in the studios and in the recovery zone. Bring a refillable bottle.
- The front desk shop sells bottled water, protein shakes and energy drinks (card or cash).

title: Wi-Fi and Other Amenities
text:
Wi-Fi and Other Amenities — Shop
Padlocks ($6), boxing hand wraps ($8), grip socks, towels and IronPulse-branded clothing.

title: Wi-Fi and Other Amenities
text:
Wi-Fi and Other Amenities — Reception lounge
Seating, phone charging points and a notice board for community events. The lounge is open during staffed hours.

title: Wi-Fi and Other Amenities
text:
Wi-Fi and Other Amenities — Not available
There is no café, no crèche, and no laundry service.

title: Group Classes FAQ
text:
Group Classes FAQ — Which plans include classes?
Plus includes one class per week (Monday–Sunday) and Elite includes unlimited classes. Basic and Student members cannot book classes; there is no pay-per-class option.

title: Group Classes FAQ
section: Which class should I start with?
text:
Group Classes FAQ — Which class should I start with?
- New to exercise: Yoga, Pilates, Core or Restorative Yoga.
- Want to get fitter fast: HIIT, Spin or Bootcamp.
- Want to get stronger: Strength (Alex starts beginners with an empty bar).
- Want to learn to punch: Boxing (no sparring).

title: Group Classes FAQ
section: How far ahead can I book?
text:
Group Classes FAQ — How far ahead can I book?
Up to 7 days ahead, maximum 4 future bookings at a time.

title: Group Classes FAQ
section: What if the class is full?
text:
Group Classes FAQ — What if the class is full?
Join the waitlist in the app. Elite members are placed ahead of Plus members.

title: Group Classes FAQ
text:
Group Classes FAQ — What if I'm late?
HIIT and Spin doors close 10 minutes after the start; Restorative Yoga has no entry after 10:15am; other classes allow late entry up to 10 minutes after the start.

title: Group Classes FAQ
section: Are there classes on public holidays?
text:
Group Classes FAQ — Are there classes on public holidays?
No. There are no group classes on public holidays.

title: Community Events
text:
Community Events — Monthly Community Challenge
- On the last Saturday of each month, the 9:00am Bootcamp becomes the IronPulse Community Challenge, led by Jordan Lee.
- Teams of four complete a timed circuit; results go on the leaderboard in the reception lounge.
- Open to Plus and Elite members (it counts as a class booking). Members can bring one guest using a guest pass or a $10 guest day pass.

title: Community Events
text:
Community Events — Lifting Technique Check
Free 20-minute technique checks with Marcus Webb on the first Sunday of each month at 12:00pm, at the lifting platforms. Open to all members; first come, first served.

title: Community Events
text:
Community Events — New Member Social
Every second Thursday of the month at 7:30pm in the reception lounge: meet the trainers and other new members. Free, no booking needed.

title: Community Events
text:
Community Events — Charity Spin-a-thon
Once a year in November, a 6-hour relay on the spin bikes raises money for a local charity. Details are announced in the app in October.

title: Day Passes for Non-Members
text:
Day Passes for Non-Members — Non-member day pass — $15
- For visitors who want to train without a membership and without a member.
- Valid for one day during staffed hours only (Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm).
- Includes the gym floor, changing rooms and showers. It does not include classes or the sauna.
- Photo ID and a health questionnaire are required; visitors must be 18+ (16–17 with a guardian present to sign the waiver).
- Maximum 4 non-member day passes per person per calendar month.

title: Day Passes for Non-Members
text:
Day Passes for Non-Members — Guest day pass — $10
For someone training with a member (see the Guest Policy). Elite members get 2 free guest passes per month.

title: Day Passes for Non-Members
section: Does a day pass count towards joining?
text:
Day Passes for Non-Members — Does a day pass count towards joining?
If you join within 7 days of buying a non-member day pass, the $15 is taken off your joining fee.

title: Day Passes for Non-Members
text:
Day Passes for Non-Members — Where to buy
At the front desk only, by card or cash.

title: Your First Visit
text:
Your First Visit — Before you come
- Download the IronPulse app and log in — your entry QR code is under "My card".
- Pack training shoes (closed-toe), a water bottle, a towel (or rent one for $2) and a padlock for the day lockers.

title: Your First Visit
text:
Your First Visit — When you arrive
1. Scan your card or QR code at the entrance.
2. Say hello at the front desk: we'll show you the changing rooms and help you book your free 30-minute intro session (it must be used within your first 30 days).
3. Set up your profile photo if you haven't yet.

title: Your First Visit
text:
Your First Visit — On the gym floor
- Ask any staff member in an IronPulse t-shirt for help with equipment.
- Wipe down equipment after use and re-rack your weights.
- Quietest times to learn the ropes: weekdays 10:00am–3:00pm.

title: Your First Visit
text:
Your First Visit — Your first class
If your plan includes classes (Plus or Elite), arrive 10 minutes early and tell the instructor it's your first time.

title: Should I Freeze or Cancel?
section: I'm travelling for a month or two
text:
Should I Freeze or Cancel? — I'm travelling for a month or two
Freeze. A standard freeze costs $5 per month, lasts up to 3 months per year, and keeps your current price and personal locker. Request it at least 7 days before it starts.

title: Should I Freeze or Cancel?
text:
Should I Freeze or Cancel? — I'm injured or ill
Ask for a medical freeze: up to 6 months, no fee, with a doctor's or physiotherapist's note. No 7-day notice needed.

title: Should I Freeze or Cancel?
section: I'm moving away or want to stop for good
text:
Should I Freeze or Cancel? — I'm moving away or want to stop for good
Cancel with 30 days' written notice (front desk form or email). There is no refund for the current month, and the $20 joining fee applies if you rejoin later.

title: Should I Freeze or Cancel?
section: I can't afford it right now
text:
Should I Freeze or Cancel? — I can't afford it right now
You could downgrade (for example Elite to Plus, or Plus to Basic) from the next billing month instead of cancelling, or freeze for up to 3 months at $5 per month.

title: Should I Freeze or Cancel?
section: I joined in the last 7 days and changed my mind
text:
Should I Freeze or Cancel? — I joined in the last 7 days and changed my mind
Use the cooling-off period: a full refund of the first month's fee if you have visited no more than 2 times (the joining fee isn't refunded).

title: Gift Memberships
section: What can I buy as a gift?
text:
Gift Memberships — What can I buy as a gift?
- A 1-month Plus gift card: $49.
- A 1-month Elite gift card: $79.
- A personal training 5-session pack: $250.
Gift cards for the Basic and Student plans are not sold.

title: Gift Memberships
text:
Gift Memberships — Rules
- Gift cards are bought at the front desk and printed on the spot or emailed.
- They must be activated within 12 months of purchase. The 1-month membership starts on the activation day.
- The person receiving the gift doesn't pay the $20 joining fee for the gift month.
- At the end of the gift month the membership simply stops; it only continues if the recipient signs up and adds a payment method.
- Gift cards can't be exchanged for cash or used to pay an existing member's monthly fee.

title: Gift Memberships
text:
Gift Memberships — Can existing members receive one?
Existing members can use a personal training gift pack, but not a membership gift card.

title: Gym Tours
section: Do I need to book a tour?
text:
Gym Tours — Do I need to book a tour?
No. Free tours are available any time during staffed hours (Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm), no appointment needed. Just ask at the front desk.

title: Gym Tours
text:
Gym Tours — What does a tour include?
About 15 minutes: the gym floor, studios, recovery zone, changing rooms and (from the doorway) the sauna. You can watch the last few minutes of a class if one is running.

title: Gym Tours
section: Can I train on the day of my tour?
text:
Gym Tours — Can I train on the day of my tour?
Not on the tour itself. To train the same day, buy a $15 non-member day pass, or join and start straight away.

title: Gym Tours
text:
Gym Tours — Can I bring someone?
Yes, friends and family are welcome on a tour. Under-16s can join the tour with a parent but cannot use the equipment.

title: Gym Tours
text:
Gym Tours — Group or accessibility tours
For groups of more than 4, corporate visits, or an accessibility-focused tour, email hello@ironpulsefitness.example to arrange a time.

title: How to Join IronPulse
text:
How to Join IronPulse — Where can I sign up?
At the front desk during staffed hours, or in the IronPulse member app (Join tab). Corporate and Student memberships must be completed at the front desk because we need to check your ID.

title: How to Join IronPulse
text:
How to Join IronPulse — What do I need?
- Photo ID (and a student ID for the Student plan, or your work email and staff ID for corporate membership).
- A bank account for direct debit or a debit/credit card.
- About 10 minutes to complete the health questionnaire (PAR-Q).
- 16–17 year olds need a parent or guardian with them to sign the waiver.

title: How to Join IronPulse
section: What do I pay on the first day?
text:
How to Join IronPulse — What do I pay on the first day?
The $20 joining fee plus the rest of the current month, worked out per day. Full monthly billing starts on the 1st.

title: How to Join IronPulse
section: Can I try before I join?
text:
How to Join IronPulse — Can I try before I join?
Yes: book a free tour any time during staffed hours, or buy a $15 non-member day pass.

title: How to Join IronPulse
text:
How to Join IronPulse — When can I start?
Straight away. Your access card is printed at the front desk, or use the QR code in the app.

title: Member App Guide
text:
Member App Guide — Overview
The IronPulse app is free on iOS and Android. Log in with the email address on your membership.

title: Member App Guide
text:
Member App Guide — Main features
- **My card:** your entry QR code (works at the door and the car park exit).
- **Classes:** see the schedule, book (Plus and Elite), cancel, and join waitlists.
- **Account:** change plan, update your payment card, view receipts, and request a freeze with the Freeze form.
- **Messages:** send a message to the front desk; replies within 1 working day.
- **Report:** report faulty equipment or a conduct issue (can be anonymous).
- **Info:** opening hours, the monthly Wi-Fi password and event notices.

title: Member App Guide
text:
Member App Guide — What the app can't do
- Cancel your membership (use the front desk form or email membership@ironpulsefitness.example).
- Book personal training or the free intro session (book at the front desk).

title: Member App Guide
text:
Member App Guide — Problems
If the app won't log in, use "Forgot password". If your QR code doesn't open the door, check your membership status under Account or ask at the front desk.

title: New Member FAQ
text:
New Member FAQ — Is there a contract?
No minimum contract on any plan. You can cancel with 30 days' written notice.

title: New Member FAQ
text:
New Member FAQ — Can I change plans later?
Yes. Upgrades start immediately (you pay the difference for the rest of the month); downgrades start from the next billing month.

title: New Member FAQ
section: What if I don't know how to use the equipment?
text:
New Member FAQ — What if I don't know how to use the equipment?
Book your free 30-minute intro session in your first 30 days. Staff on the gym floor can also show you any machine during staffed hours.

title: New Member FAQ
text:
New Member FAQ — Can I bring a friend?
Yes, during staffed hours: Elite members get 2 free guest passes a month; otherwise a guest pays a $10 guest day pass.

title: New Member FAQ
text:
New Member FAQ — Can I pause my membership?
Yes — freeze for up to 3 months per year at $5 per month (request at least 7 days ahead), or a free medical freeze of up to 6 months with a doctor's note.

title: New Member FAQ
text:
New Member FAQ — Where do I park?
Free for 2 hours in the Ridgeway Plaza car park; validate your ticket at the front desk.

title: New Member FAQ
text:
New Member FAQ — Who do I contact?
The front desk on (555) 014-2290 during staffed hours, or hello@ironpulsefitness.example.

title: Basic Membership Plan
text:
Basic Membership Plan — Overview
The Basic plan is IronPulse Fitness's entry-level membership for people who want access to the gym floor and train on their own.

title: Basic Membership Plan
text:
Basic Membership Plan — Price
- $29 per month, billed on the 1st of each month.
- A one-time $20 joining fee is paid with the first month.
- No minimum contract: cancel any time with 30 days' written notice.

title: Basic Membership Plan
text:
Basic Membership Plan — What's included
- Full access to the gym floor (free weights, machines, cardio area, stretching zone) during staffed hours only: Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm.
- Use of changing rooms, showers and day lockers (bring your own padlock).
- One free 30-minute intro session with a trainer in your first 30 days.
- The IronPulse member app for entry by QR code.

title: Basic Membership Plan
text:
Basic Membership Plan — What's not included
- Group classes are not included. Basic members cannot book classes; upgrade to Plus (one class per week) or Elite (unlimited classes) to join them.
- No 24/7 access — the door scanner only admits Basic members during staffed hours.
- No sauna access and no guest passes (guests pay the $10 guest day pass).

title: Basic Membership Plan
text:
Basic Membership Plan — Who it suits
Members who train during the day or evening, already know their way around a gym, and don't need classes.

title: Corporate Membership Programme
text:
Corporate Membership Programme — Overview
IronPulse Fitness partners with local employers so their staff can join at a reduced rate.

title: Corporate Membership Programme
text:
Corporate Membership Programme — The offer
- Employees of a registered partner company get 15% off the Plus or Elite monthly price: Plus is $41.65 and Elite is $67.15 per month.
- The joining fee is waived for corporate members.
- The discount does not apply to Basic or Student, to personal training, or to guest passes.

title: Corporate Membership Programme
text:
Corporate Membership Programme — Eligibility
- The employer must be a registered IronPulse corporate partner with at least 5 employees signed up.
- Sign up at the front desk with your work email address and staff ID. We confirm eligibility with the employer's HR contact.
- If you leave the partner company, the membership continues at the normal price from the next billing month.

title: Corporate Membership Programme
text:
Corporate Membership Programme — Becoming a partner company
Employers can register by emailing corporate@ironpulsefitness.example. There is no cost to the company. Partner companies receive a monthly usage summary (number of active members only — no individual attendance data is shared).

title: Corporate Membership Programme
text:
Corporate Membership Programme — Important
This is the only discount IronPulse offers besides the Student plan. Staff cannot apply unofficial discounts, even if a manager is said to have approved one.

title: Elite Membership Plan
text:
Elite Membership Plan — Overview
Elite is IronPulse's all-inclusive membership.

title: Elite Membership Plan
text:
Elite Membership Plan — Price
- $79 per month, plus the one-time $20 joining fee.

title: Elite Membership Plan
text:
Elite Membership Plan — What's included
- Everything in Plus, including 24/7 access and a permanent locker.
- Unlimited group classes, booked up to 7 days ahead.
- Two guest passes per month. Guest passes reset on the 1st of each month and do not roll over.
- Sauna access (6:00am–9:00pm daily, see the Sauna Rules).
- Towel service: a fresh towel at the front desk on every visit.
- Priority waitlist: when a class is full, Elite members are placed ahead of Plus members on the waitlist.

title: Elite Membership Plan
text:
Elite Membership Plan — Fair use for unlimited classes
To keep classes available for everyone, an Elite member who has three no-shows within 30 days cannot book classes for 7 days. Cancelling at least 2 hours before the class is never counted as a no-show.

title: Elite Membership Plan
text:
Elite Membership Plan — Who it suits
Members who take two or more classes a week, bring friends, or want the sauna and towel service. If you take only one class a week, Plus is cheaper.

title: Membership Plan Comparison
text:
Membership Plan Comparison — Overview
All prices are per month. Every plan has a one-time $20 joining fee and no minimum contract.

title: Membership Plan Comparison
text:
Membership Plan Comparison — Plans side by side
- Basic — $29/month: gym floor during staffed hours only, no group classes, day lockers, no guest passes, no sauna, towel rental $2.
- Student — $24/month: same as Basic, needs a valid student ID.
- Plus — $49/month: 24/7 gym floor access, 1 group class per week, personal locker, no guest passes, no sauna, towel rental $2.
- Elite — $79/month: 24/7 access, unlimited group classes, personal locker, 2 guest passes per month, sauna, towel service included, priority waitlist.

title: Membership Plan Comparison
text:
Membership Plan Comparison — Quick guide
- The cheapest plan with 24/7 access is Plus ($49).
- The only plan with unlimited classes is Elite ($79).
- The cheapest plan overall is Student ($24), for full-time students with a valid ID.
- Staffed hours are Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm and Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm.

title: Membership Plan Comparison
text:
Membership Plan Comparison — Yearly cost
Twelve months on each plan, excluding the joining fee: Basic $348, Student $288, Plus $588, Elite $948.

title: Plus Membership Plan
text:
Plus Membership Plan — Overview
Plus is our most popular plan. It is the cheapest IronPulse plan with 24/7 access.

title: Plus Membership Plan
text:
Plus Membership Plan — Price
- $49 per month, plus the one-time $20 joining fee.

title: Plus Membership Plan
text:
Plus Membership Plan — What's included
- 24/7 access to the gym floor with your access card or app QR code, including the unstaffed hours (see the 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours policy).
- One group class per week. The week runs Monday to Sunday; unused classes do not roll over to the next week.
- A permanent personal locker in the changing room (the locker key card is issued at the front desk).
- Changing rooms, showers, the member app and a free intro session.

title: Plus Membership Plan
text:
Plus Membership Plan — What's not included
- Only one class per week — for more, upgrade to Elite (unlimited classes).
- No sauna access and no included guest passes (guests pay $10 per day).
- Towels are not included: bring your own or rent one for $2.

title: Plus Membership Plan
text:
Plus Membership Plan — Booking your weekly class
Plus members book through the member app or front desk up to 7 days ahead. A late cancellation (less than 2 hours before the class) or a no-show counts as your class for that week.

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Overview
A complete list of IronPulse Fitness charges in one place.

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Memberships
- Per month: Basic $29, Student $24, Plus $49, Elite $79.
- Joining fee (one time, all plans): $20 — waived only for corporate partner members.

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Visits without a membership
- Guest day pass (accompanied by a member): $10.
- Non-member day pass (no member needed): $15, valid during staffed hours only, photo ID required.

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Personal training
- Single 60-minute session: $55.
- 5-session pack: $250 (valid 3 months).
- 10-session pack: $460 (valid 6 months).

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Extras
- Towel rental: $2 (included for Elite).
- Replacement access card: $10 (first card free).
- Padlock for day lockers: $6.
- Boxing hand wraps: $8 (gloves can be borrowed free).

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Account charges
- Membership freeze: $5 per month while frozen (no charge for a medical freeze with a doctor's note).
- Failed payment fee: $10, charged only if the retry also fails.

title: Price List and Fees
text:
Price List and Fees — Payment methods
Monthly memberships are paid by direct debit or by a debit/credit card on file. Day passes, towels, padlocks and wraps can be paid by card or cash at the front desk.

title: Student Membership Plan
text:
Student Membership Plan — Overview
The Student plan gives full-time students the Basic membership at a lower price.

title: Student Membership Plan
text:
Student Membership Plan — Price
- $24 per month.
- The $20 joining fee still applies.

title: Student Membership Plan
text:
Student Membership Plan — Eligibility
- You must show a valid student ID from a university, college or high school (age 16+, see the Age Policy) when you sign up.
- Student status is re-checked every September. If you can't show a current student ID by 30 September, the membership automatically moves to the Basic plan at $29 per month from the next billing month.

title: Student Membership Plan
text:
Student Membership Plan — What's included
Exactly the same as the Basic plan:
- Gym floor access during staffed hours only (Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm).
- Changing rooms, showers, day lockers, the member app, and one free intro session.

title: Student Membership Plan
text:
Student Membership Plan — What's not included
- No group classes, no 24/7 access, no sauna, no guest passes.
- Students who want classes can upgrade to Plus or Elite at the normal price; there is no student version of those plans.

title: Access Card and QR Entry
text:
Access Card and QR Entry — Getting in
Members enter with either the IronPulse access card or the QR code in the member app. Both work the same way at the door scanner.

title: Access Card and QR Entry
text:
Access Card and QR Entry — Cards
- Your first access card is free, issued at the front desk when you join (photo taken for the member record).
- Lost or damaged cards are replaced for $10 at the front desk. Report a lost card in the app straight away so it can be blocked.
- The QR code works as a free backup while you wait for a new card.

title: Access Card and QR Entry
text:
Access Card and QR Entry — Personal use only
Cards and QR codes are personal and cannot be shared. The door system flags two entries on the same card within 10 minutes; a shared card leads to suspension of the membership.

title: Access Card and QR Entry
section: When the scanner won't let you in
text:
Access Card and QR Entry — When the scanner won't let you in
Common reasons: arriving outside your plan's access hours (Basic and Student: staffed hours only), a frozen or suspended membership, or an unpaid balance. Ask at the front desk or check Account in the app.

title: Age Policy
text:
Age Policy — Who can join
- 18 and over: standard membership on any plan.
- 16–17: can join any plan with a parent or guardian's waiver, signed in person at the front desk with photo ID for both.
- Under 16: cannot use the gym floor, classes or sauna, and cannot visit as a guest.

title: Age Policy
text:
Age Policy — Extra rules for 16–17 year olds
- No access during unstaffed 24/7 hours, even on the Plus or Elite plan. Access is limited to staffed hours until the member turns 18.
- No sauna access until 18, including on the Elite plan.
- They must complete a free intro session before training alone.

title: Age Policy
text:
Age Policy — Turning 18
24/7 access and sauna access (for Elite) are switched on automatically from the member's 18th birthday.

title: Billing and Payments
text:
Billing and Payments — When you are billed
- Memberships are billed monthly on the 1st of each month.
- If you join mid-month, your first payment covers the rest of that month, worked out per day, plus the $20 joining fee. Full monthly billing starts on the next 1st.

title: Billing and Payments
text:
Billing and Payments — How you pay
- Direct debit from a bank account, or a debit/credit card stored on your account.
- Update your card in the member app (Account → Payment method) or at the front desk.
- IronPulse does not accept cash for monthly memberships.

title: Billing and Payments
text:
Billing and Payments — Receipts and invoices
Receipts are emailed after every payment and available in the app under Account → Payments. Company invoices for corporate members are issued on request.

title: Billing and Payments
text:
Billing and Payments — Price changes
We give at least 30 days' notice by email before any price change. Frozen memberships keep the price they had before the freeze.

title: Billing and Payments
text:
Billing and Payments — Questions
Billing questions: billing@ironpulsefitness.example or the front desk during staffed hours. For missed payments, see the Failed Payments policy.

title: Cancellation Policy
text:
Cancellation Policy — Overview
IronPulse memberships have no minimum contract, but cancelling needs notice.

title: Cancellation Policy
text:
Cancellation Policy — How to cancel
- Give 30 days' written notice: fill in the cancellation form at the front desk, or email membership@ironpulsefitness.example from the email address on your account.
- Cancelling by phone, in the app chat, or by cancelling your direct debit with the bank is not accepted as notice.
- You will receive a confirmation email with your last day of membership within 2 working days.

title: Cancellation Policy
text:
Cancellation Policy — Payments and refunds
- Your last payment covers the 30-day notice period, so you may pay for one more month after giving notice.
- There is no refund for the current month.
- Unused personal training sessions are not refunded and stay valid until the pack expires.

title: Cancellation Policy
text:
Cancellation Policy — Consider a freeze instead
If you need a break for travel, work or a short injury, a freeze may suit you better: up to 3 months per year for $5 per month, with your price locked. For injury or illness, a medical freeze has no fee.

title: Cancellation Policy
text:
Cancellation Policy — Rejoining
You are welcome back at any time. The $20 joining fee applies again, at the current plan prices.

title: Cancellation Policy
text:
Cancellation Policy — New members
If you joined less than 7 days ago, see the Cooling-Off Period policy.

title: Children and Pets
text:
Children and Pets — Children
- Under-16s are not allowed on the gym floor, in classes or in the sauna, even with a parent.
- IronPulse has no crèche or childcare service.
- Children may wait in the reception lounge only if supervised by another adult who is not training.
- Members aged 16–17 can join with a guardian's waiver (see the Age Policy).

title: Children and Pets
text:
Children and Pets — Pets
- Pets are not allowed anywhere inside the building.
- Registered assistance dogs are welcome in all areas except the sauna and showers. Please tell the front desk on your first visit.
- Dogs may not be left tied up outside the entrance or in parked cars on hot days.

title: Member Code of Conduct
text:
Member Code of Conduct — Overview
IronPulse should feel welcoming for everyone. All members and guests agree to this code when they join or visit.

title: Member Code of Conduct
text:
Member Code of Conduct — Expected behaviour
- Treat other members and staff with respect. Harassment, discrimination, intimidation or unwanted comments about anyone's body are not tolerated.
- Share equipment: let others "work in" between sets and don't reserve machines with towels or bags.
- Keep noise reasonable — controlled grunting is fine, shouting and slamming weights are not.
- Personal music only with headphones.

title: Member Code of Conduct
text:
Member Code of Conduct — Not allowed
- Bringing food onto the gym floor (sealed drinks and protein shakes in closed bottles are fine).
- Selling products or services, or coaching other members for money (only IronPulse trainers may train clients).
- Letting anyone else in on your access card or QR code, or holding the door open for people during unstaffed hours.

title: Member Code of Conduct
text:
Member Code of Conduct — Consequences
A first minor breach gets a verbal warning. Serious or repeated breaches lead to suspension or cancellation of the membership without refund. Report problems to staff or with the Report form in the app — reports can be anonymous.

title: Cooling-Off Period for New Members
text:
Cooling-Off Period for New Members — Overview
New members can change their mind shortly after joining.

title: Cooling-Off Period for New Members
text:
Cooling-Off Period for New Members — The rule
- If you cancel within 7 days of signing up, and you have visited the gym no more than 2 times, you get a full refund of your first month's membership fee.
- The $20 joining fee is not refunded.
- The 30-day notice period does not apply during the cooling-off period.

title: Cooling-Off Period for New Members
text:
Cooling-Off Period for New Members — How to use it
Tell the front desk in person or email membership@ironpulsefitness.example within the 7 days. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 working days.

title: Cooling-Off Period for New Members
text:
Cooling-Off Period for New Members — After 7 days
The standard Cancellation Policy applies: 30 days' written notice and no refund for the current month.

title: Dress Code
section: On the gym floor and in classes
text:
Dress Code — On the gym floor and in classes
- Closed-toe athletic shoes must be worn at all times. Sandals, flip-flops, boots and bare feet are not allowed.
- Exceptions: Yoga, Pilates and Restorative Yoga are done barefoot or in grip socks; deadlift slippers and flat lifting shoes are fine on the lifting platforms.
- Wear clean athletic clothing that covers the torso — a sports bra or a vest is fine, no shirtless training.
- No clothing with offensive slogans or images.

title: Dress Code
text:
Dress Code — In the sauna
Swimwear or a towel wrap is required; no street clothes or shoes.

title: Dress Code
text:
Dress Code — Why
The rules protect your feet from dropped weights, keep equipment hygienic, and make the gym comfortable for everyone. Staff may ask a member to change or to leave the floor if the dress code is not followed.

title: Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules
text:
Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules — Clean as you go
Wipe down benches, machines, mats and handles after use with the spray and paper towels at each station.

title: Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules
text:
Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules — Put it back
Re-rack plates, dumbbells and kettlebells after every exercise. Don't leave plates on bars or leg press machines.

title: Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules
text:
Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules — Cardio time limits
During peak hours (Monday–Friday 5:00pm–8:00pm), cardio machines are limited to 30 minutes when others are waiting.

title: Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules
text:
Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules — Lifting platforms and chalk
- Chalk is allowed on the lifting platforms only; use the chalk bowl, not your own loose chalk.
- Controlled drops of bumper plates are allowed on platforms only. Never drop dumbbells or iron plates.
- Use collars on loaded barbells.

title: Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules
text:
Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules — Squat racks
Racks are for exercises that need the rack (squats, presses, rack pulls). Bicep curls in the squat rack are not allowed during peak hours.

title: Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules
text:
Equipment Etiquette and Gym Floor Rules — Faulty equipment
Report broken or unsafe equipment to staff or with the Report form in the app, and put an "Out of order" tag on it (tags are at the front desk).

title: Failed Payments
section: What happens if a payment fails
text:
Failed Payments — What happens if a payment fails
1. Day 0: the monthly payment fails. You get an email and an app notification. There is no fee yet.
2. Day 3: we retry the payment automatically.
3. If the retry also fails, a $10 failed payment fee is added and your access card is paused until the balance is paid. You can pay at the front desk or in the app at any time.
4. Day 14: if the balance is still unpaid, the membership is suspended and class bookings are cancelled.
5. Day 30: an unpaid membership is cancelled and the balance is passed to our collections partner.

title: Failed Payments
text:
Failed Payments — Avoiding a failed payment
Keep your card details up to date in the app. If you know a payment will fail, contact billing@ironpulsefitness.example before the 1st — we can move the payment date by up to 5 days once per year.

title: Failed Payments
text:
Failed Payments — Fee waivers
The $10 fee is only removed if the failure was caused by an IronPulse or bank system error.

title: Membership Freeze Policy
text:
Membership Freeze Policy — Overview
A freeze pauses your membership for a while (for example travel or a busy period) without cancelling it.

title: Membership Freeze Policy
text:
Membership Freeze Policy — The rules
- You can freeze for up to 3 months per calendar year, in blocks of whole months (1, 2 or 3 months).
- A freeze is not free: while frozen you pay $5 per month instead of your normal plan price.
- Request it at least 7 days before the freeze should start, at the front desk or with the Freeze form in the member app.
- Freezes start on the 1st of a month and end on the last day of a month.

title: Membership Freeze Policy
text:
Membership Freeze Policy — While your membership is frozen
- Your access card is deactivated and class bookings are cancelled.
- Your price is locked: you return at the same monthly price you paid before the freeze.
- Plus and Elite members keep their personal locker during the freeze.
- Personal training packs pause too, and their validity is extended by the frozen time.

title: Membership Freeze Policy
text:
Membership Freeze Policy — Ending early
You can unfreeze early by asking at the front desk. Your normal plan price starts again from the next billing date (the 1st).

title: Membership Freeze Policy
text:
Membership Freeze Policy — Longer breaks
If you need more than 3 months off, you can cancel instead (30 days' written notice) and rejoin later; the $20 joining fee applies again when you rejoin. For injuries or illness, see the Medical Freeze policy.

title: Guest Policy
text:
Guest Policy — Overview
Members can bring a friend to train with them.

title: Guest Policy
text:
Guest Policy — Prices
- Elite members get 2 free guest passes per month. They reset on the 1st and do not roll over.
- All other guests pay a $10 guest day pass at the front desk.
- Someone visiting without a member can buy a $15 non-member day pass instead.

title: Guest Policy
text:
Guest Policy — Rules for guests
- Guests must be 18 or older, or 16–17 with a parent or guardian signing the waiver in person.
- Photo ID is required, and guests complete a short health questionnaire on their first visit.
- A member can bring one guest at a time, and must stay with the guest for the whole visit.
- Guests may only visit during staffed hours (Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm). Guests are never allowed during unstaffed 24/7 hours.
- The same guest can visit at most 3 times per calendar month; after that we ask them to consider joining.

title: Guest Policy
text:
Guest Policy — Classes and sauna
Guests may join a group class only if there is space 2 hours before the start and the member books it for them using the member's own class allowance. Guests of Elite members may use the sauna with the member.

title: Health, Safety and Medical Clearance
text:
Health, Safety and Medical Clearance — Health questionnaire
Every new member and first-time guest completes a short health questionnaire (PAR-Q) when signing up.

title: Health, Safety and Medical Clearance
Health, Safety and Medical Clearance
text:
Health, Safety and Medical Clearance — Injuries at the gym
- All staff hold first-aid and CPR certificates. An AED (defibrillator) is next to the front desk and a second one is by the lifting platforms.
- Report any injury to staff straight away; staff complete an incident report.
- IronPulse staff and trainers do not diagnose or treat injuries. For pain or injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

title: Health, Safety and Medical Clearance
text:
Health, Safety and Medical Clearance — Hydration and illness
Water fountains are on the gym floor and in the studios. Please don't train with a fever or a contagious illness.

title: Lost and Found
text:
Lost and Found — Where lost items go
Items found in the gym, studios and changing rooms are taken to the front desk and logged.

title: Lost and Found
text:
Lost and Found — How long we keep them
- Clothing, bottles and towels: 14 days, then donated to a local charity.
- Valuables (phones, wallets, keys, jewellery, cards): 30 days in the office safe, then handed to the local police station.
- Day lockers are emptied every night at 11:00pm. Their contents are treated as lost property.

title: Lost and Found
text:
Lost and Found — Claiming an item
Ask at the front desk during staffed hours and describe the item; valuables need photo ID to collect. You can also report a lost item with the Lost property form in the app and we'll notify you if it turns up.

title: Lost and Found
text:
Lost and Found — Responsibility
IronPulse is not responsible for items left unattended or in day lockers. Please use a padlock (sold at the front desk for $6).

title: Medical Freeze
text:
Medical Freeze — Overview
Members who can't train because of injury, illness, surgery or pregnancy can apply for a medical freeze instead of a standard freeze.

title: Medical Freeze
section: How it differs from a standard freeze
text:
Medical Freeze — How it differs from a standard freeze
- Length: up to 6 months (a standard freeze is up to 3 months per year).
- Cost: no fee — the $5 monthly freeze fee is not charged.
- Notice: no 7-day notice needed; it can start from the date on your doctor's note, backdated by up to 14 days.

title: Medical Freeze
text:
Medical Freeze — What you need
- A doctor's or physiotherapist's note stating that you should not exercise and for roughly how long.
- Hand it in at the front desk or upload it with the Freeze form in the member app. Notes are seen only by the membership manager and deleted once the freeze ends.

title: Medical Freeze
text:
Medical Freeze — Coming back
- Your membership restarts at the same monthly price.
- We recommend booking a free return-to-training check with a trainer (Priya Nair specialises in post-rehabilitation exercise).
- Some conditions need written medical clearance before you return (see Health, Safety and Medical Clearance).

title: Photography and Filming Policy
text:
Photography and Filming Policy — Filming yourself
You may film or photograph your own workout for personal use (for example to check your lifting technique), as long as no other member is identifiable in the shot.

title: Photography and Filming Policy
text:
Photography and Filming Policy — Not allowed
- Filming or photographing other members or staff without their clear permission.
- Any photography or filming in the changing rooms, showers or sauna — this leads to immediate cancellation of membership.
- Setting up tripods in walkways or on the cardio floor; use the marked filming spots next to the lifting platforms.

title: Photography and Filming Policy
text:
Photography and Filming Policy — Commercial content
Influencer, brand or professional shoots need written permission from the gym manager at least 7 days in advance (email hello@ironpulsefitness.example) and usually take place outside peak hours.

title: Photography and Filming Policy
text:
Photography and Filming Policy — Classes
Instructors may take photos of classes for IronPulse social media only after announcing it; tell the instructor if you don't want to appear.

title: Privacy and CCTV
text:
Privacy and CCTV — What we store
Your name, contact details, date of birth, photo, plan and payment details, entry log, class bookings and health questionnaire answers.

title: Privacy and CCTV
text:
Privacy and CCTV — How it is used
Only to run your membership: access control, billing, bookings and safety. We never sell member data. Marketing emails are opt-in and can be turned off in the app.

title: Privacy and CCTV
text:
Privacy and CCTV — How long we keep it
- Entry logs and booking history: 2 years.
- Health questionnaire and doctor's notes: deleted 12 months after the membership ends (doctor's notes for medical freezes are deleted when the freeze ends).
- CCTV footage: 30 days, unless needed for an incident investigation.

title: Privacy and CCTV
text:
Privacy and CCTV — CCTV
Cameras cover the entrance, gym floor, studios, car park and corridors. There are no cameras in changing rooms, showers or the sauna.

title: Privacy and CCTV
text:
Privacy and CCTV — Your rights
You can request a copy of your data, a correction or deletion by emailing privacy@ironpulsefitness.example. We reply within 30 days.

title: 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours
text:
24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours — Overview
Plus and Elite members (aged 18+) can enter the gym at any time with their access card or app QR code. Outside staffed hours the gym is unstaffed.

title: 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours
text:
24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours — Staffed and unstaffed times
- Staffed: Monday–Friday 6:00am–10:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 8:00am–8:00pm.
- Unstaffed: all other times. The front desk, studios and sauna are closed; the gym floor, changing rooms and showers stay open.

title: 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours
text:
24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours — Safety during unstaffed hours
- Help points with an emergency button are by the entrance, the lifting platforms and the changing rooms. They connect to a 24-hour monitoring centre that can call emergency services.
- CCTV covers all areas except changing rooms and showers.
- We recommend training with a partner for heavy lifts; use the safety arms in the squat racks.

title: 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours
text:
24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours — Rules
- No guests and no under-18s during unstaffed hours.
- Tailgating (letting someone in behind you) is a serious breach of the Code of Conduct.
- Each entry is logged against your card.

title: 24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours
text:
24/7 Access and Unstaffed Hours — Not available to
Basic and Student members, whose cards only work during staffed hours.

title: Changing Your Plan: Upgrades and Downgrades
section: Upgrading (e.g. Basic to Plus, Plus to Elite)
text:
Changing Your Plan: Upgrades and Downgrades — Upgrading (e.g. Basic to Plus, Plus to Elite)
- Takes effect immediately, at the front desk or in the member app (Account → Change plan).
- You pay the difference for the rest of the current month, worked out per day. Example: upgrading from Plus ($49) to Elite ($79) on the 16th of a 30-day month costs about $15 extra for that month.
- New benefits (24/7 access, classes, sauna, guest passes) work the same day. Elite guest passes are given in full for the month you upgrade.
- No new joining fee.

title: Changing Your Plan: Upgrades and Downgrades
section: Downgrading (e.g. Elite to Plus, Plus to Basic)
text:
Changing Your Plan: Upgrades and Downgrades — Downgrading (e.g. Elite to Plus, Plus to Basic)
- Takes effect from the next billing month (the 1st). There is no refund for the current month.
- Request it at least 7 days before the 1st.
- Class bookings that are no longer included are cancelled when the downgrade starts. If you downgrade from Plus or Elite to Basic, your personal locker must be emptied by the last day of the month.

title: Changing Your Plan: Upgrades and Downgrades
text:
Changing Your Plan: Upgrades and Downgrades — Moving to the Student plan
Requires a valid student ID and starts from the next billing month.

title: Trainer Bio: Alex Chen
text:
Trainer Bio: Alex Chen — Overview
Alex Chen is IronPulse's head coach for strength and boxing, and has coached at IronPulse since it opened in 2019.

title: Trainer Bio: Alex Chen
text:
Trainer Bio: Alex Chen — Background
- Former amateur boxer (regional middleweight finalist, 2014).
- Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) and Level 2 boxing coach.
- Specialises in teaching beginners the main barbell lifts safely and in strength training for members over 50.

title: Trainer Bio: Alex Chen
text:
Trainer Bio: Alex Chen — Classes Alex teaches
- Strength — Tuesday and Thursday 7:00am
- Boxing — Wednesday 6:00pm
- Core — Friday 5:00pm

title: Trainer Bio: Alex Chen
text:
Trainer Bio: Alex Chen — Personal training
Alex takes personal training clients on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings (8:00am–12:00pm). Sessions are booked through the front desk at the standard personal-training prices.

title: Trainer Bio: Alex Chen
text:
Trainer Bio: Alex Chen — Coaching style
Patient and technical: "Lift well first, lift heavy later." Alex films a short technique video for new strength members so they can review their form at home.

title: Free Intro Session
text:
Free Intro Session — Overview
Every new IronPulse member gets one free 30-minute intro session with a trainer.

title: Free Intro Session
text:
Free Intro Session — What happens in the session
- A short chat about your goals, training history and any injuries.
- A tour of the gym floor and how the main machines work.
- A simple starter workout plan written for you, saved in the member app.

title: Free Intro Session
text:
Free Intro Session — Rules
- One free session per new member, on any plan (Basic, Student, Plus or Elite).
- It must be used within your first 30 days of membership; it does not carry over after that.
- Book it at the front desk (it cannot be booked in the app). You can ask for a specific trainer, subject to availability.
- If you can't make it, cancel at least 24 hours ahead to rebook; a no-show uses up the free session.

title: Free Intro Session
text:
Free Intro Session — After the intro
Many members continue with a personal training pack; there is no obligation to buy one.

title: Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee
text:
Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee — Overview
Jordan Lee leads IronPulse's conditioning programme: HIIT, Spin and the Saturday Bootcamp.

title: Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee
text:
Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee — Background
- Former college 400m sprinter.
- Certified personal trainer and indoor cycling instructor; first-aid and CPR instructor for the IronPulse staff team.
- Joined IronPulse in 2021.

title: Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee
text:
Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee — Classes Jordan teaches
- HIIT — Monday 7:00am, Wednesday 7:00am, Thursday 6:00pm
- Spin — Monday 6:00pm, Friday 7:00am
- Bootcamp — Saturday 9:00am (and the monthly Community Challenge)

title: Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee
text:
Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee — Personal training
Jordan takes personal training clients on Tuesday and Thursday evenings (4:00pm–8:00pm), focusing on fat loss, running fitness and general conditioning.

title: Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee
text:
Trainer Bio: Jordan Lee — Coaching style
High energy, music-driven, and always gives a lower-impact option for every move so no one is left out.

title: Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb
text:
Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb — Overview
Marcus Webb is a personal trainer at IronPulse Fitness who specialises in powerlifting and muscle building. He works one-to-one only and does not teach group classes.

title: Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb
text:
Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb — Background
- Competitive powerlifter (national masters bronze medallist, 2022).
- Certified personal trainer and powerlifting coach.
- Joined IronPulse in 2022.

title: Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb
text:
Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb — Specialities
- Squat, bench press and deadlift technique and programming.
- Competition preparation, including meet-day planning.
- Muscle-building programmes for intermediate lifters.

title: Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb
text:
Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb — Availability
Tuesday and Thursday 6:00am–12:00pm, and Sunday 9:00am–1:00pm.

title: Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb
text:
Trainer Bio: Marcus Webb — Good to know
Marcus runs a free 20-minute "Lifting Technique Check" for any member on the first Sunday of each month at 12:00pm, first come first served at the lifting platforms.

title: Personal Training Packages
text:
Personal Training Packages — Overview
One-to-one coaching with any IronPulse trainer: Alex Chen, Jordan Lee, Sam Rivera, Priya Nair or Marcus Webb. Personal training is available to members on every plan; it is not included in any membership.

title: Personal Training Packages
text:
Personal Training Packages — Prices
- Single 60-minute session: $55.
- 5-session pack: $250 ($50 per session), valid for 3 months from purchase.
- 10-session pack: $460 ($46 per session), valid for 6 months from purchase.
- Partner training (two members together with one trainer): add $20 per session.

title: Personal Training Packages
text:
Personal Training Packages — Rules
- Book and pay at the front desk; the trainer confirms the time.
- Cancel at least 24 hours in advance, or the session is charged / deducted from your pack.
- Unused sessions expire at the end of the pack's validity and are not refunded.
- Packs can be paused while your membership is frozen; the validity is extended by the frozen time.

title: Personal Training Packages
text:
Personal Training Packages — First step
New members should use their free 30-minute intro session first (see Free Intro Session) to meet a trainer before buying a pack.

title: Trainer Bio: Priya Nair
text:
Trainer Bio: Priya Nair — Overview
Priya Nair is a personal trainer at IronPulse Fitness. She does not teach group classes; she works one-to-one and with pairs.

title: Trainer Bio: Priya Nair
text:
Trainer Bio: Priya Nair — Background
- BSc in Sport and Exercise Science.
- Certified personal trainer with a specialist certificate in post-rehabilitation exercise.
- Joined IronPulse in 2023.

title: Trainer Bio: Priya Nair
text:
Trainer Bio: Priya Nair — Specialities
- Returning to training after an injury, once a physiotherapist or doctor has cleared you.
- Pre- and post-natal exercise (with medical clearance).
- First-time gym users who want a structured 6-week starter programme.

title: Trainer Bio: Priya Nair
text:
Trainer Bio: Priya Nair — Availability
Monday, Wednesday and Friday 4:00pm–9:00pm, and Saturday 10:00am–2:00pm.

title: Trainer Bio: Priya Nair
text:
Trainer Bio: Priya Nair — Important
Priya does not diagnose or treat injuries. If something hurts, see a doctor or physiotherapist first; Priya then designs training around their advice.

title: Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera
text:
Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera — Overview
Sam Rivera runs IronPulse's mind-body classes: Yoga, Pilates and Restorative Yoga.

title: Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera
text:
Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera — Background
- 500-hour registered yoga teacher (RYT-500) and certified mat Pilates instructor.
- Previously a dancer; specialises in mobility, flexibility and posture.
- Joined IronPulse in 2020.

title: Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera
text:
Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera — Classes Sam teaches
- Yoga — Monday and Thursday 12:00pm
- Pilates — Tuesday and Friday 12:00pm
- Restorative Yoga — Sunday 10:00am

title: Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera
text:
Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera — Personal training
Sam offers one-to-one mobility and Pilates sessions on weekdays from 1:00pm to 4:00pm, at the standard personal-training prices.

title: Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera
text:
Trainer Bio: Sam Rivera — Coaching style
Calm and detailed. Sam is especially popular with desk workers who have stiff hips and shoulders, and with lifters who want to improve their squat depth.
